rationale: Contains-inside-loop is present, but the framework consumer is opt-in AddTagHelpersAsServices registration, not per-render discovery. The real repository opt-in fixture supplies one accepted helper; the two built-in assemblies declare 20 and 3 concrete helpers. No real large accepted-type population or repeated production lifecycle was established to justify membership storage and extra semantic complexity. A once-seeded HashSet also misses live-list mutations through public provider/enumerator extension seams. No optimization was made merely to close a count.

qualification.realProducer: ApplicationPartManager default assembly/factory discovery -> AssemblyPart.Assembly.DefinedTypes -> TagHelperFeatureProvider.IncludeType -> current List<TypeInfo>.Contains/Add
qualification.realConsumer: Both builder AddTagHelpersAsServices overloads -> fresh TagHelperFeature -> transient service registrations. Default framework code does not retain this feature; custom providers may.
qualification.realOptInFixture: ControllersFromServicesWebSite clears default parts and supplies one class-library AssemblyPart, a three-type TypesPart with one helper, and a compiled-view part that does not supply types.
qualification.countsBoundary: Counts are from pinned real source. No native reflection census or actual loaded assembly/type totals were collected.
qualification.preservedContracts: No changes. Existing entries/duplicates, default TypeInfo equality, append/part order, sequential shared-feature provider mutations and synchronous live-list callback/enumerator mutation remain untouched.
qualification.historyAndRelatedWork: history and related-work retain bounded fresh upstream/fork searches and source history. Inspected upstream #30560 is compiler descriptor discovery; fork #115 is distributed-cache buffers, not this provider.
qualification.hotReload: support-hot-reload loaded; stateless provider, no long-lived cache, API or invalidation changes.

initialSourceAttempt.cause: Overbroad static assertion required global.json to match across roles. Actual difference is Arcade/Helix/SharedFramework build SDK versions, not selected product code.

finalSourceAttempt.boundary: Finite source qualification, not native test execution or production red/green evidence.

validation.reasonNoNativeExecution: No candidate survived qualification. No private graph was needed, no target runtime was launched, and no prerequisite/build failure is claimed.
